record.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the role of Civil Services in a democratic developmental
    administration and select the correct answers:
      1. Civil services maintain institutional continuity and administrative expertise, ensuring the execution
         of public policies regardless of political transitions.
      2. The doctrine of civil service neutrality requires officers to remain ideologically detached and
         executionally loyal to the legally established government of the day.
      3. Article 311 provides constitutional protection against arbitrary dismissal or reduction in rank to
         members of the civil services.
